description:
Erection of single storey side and rear extensions, rear
outrigger roof extension with roof terrace, and four roof
windows following demolition of existing extensions.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building (brickwork and roof tiles), unless otherwise specified on the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1190-02-01, 1190-02-02, 1190-02-03, 1190-02-04, 1190-02-05, 1190-02-06, 1190-02-07 and 1190-02-08, received 17/06/2020, and 1190-01-000, 1190-01-01, 1190-01-02, 1190-01-03, 1190-01-04, 1190-01-05, 1190-01-06, 1190-01-07, 1190-01-08, 1190-01-09, 1190-01-010, Design, Access and Heritage Statement and Flood Risk Assessment, received 27/04/2020.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the rear roof extension hereby approved shall be obscure-glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The side extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 16 Sutton Court Road.
